newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly firmer in after-hours trade on Thursday, as bargain hunting emerged after falls during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.9 yen per kg higher than the day's close. Benchmark July was up 0.5 yen on the close. Volume was 6,808 lots.

During the day, prices had edged lower, depressed by sporadic selling. "Trading was basically directionless. Private investors were generally sidelined, amid uncertainty over the near-term direction in rubber producing and the currency market," one trader said.
